question: Should upgrades automatically delete unversioned failed attachment queue records carrying the historical stack-overflow signature?
rationale: The parser repair is mechanical, but automatic deletion of persisted retryable user state is an upgrade-policy choice that focused tests alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Keep targeted cleanup
options.body: Accept the narrow migration after current-head browser reload proof shows only historical attachment failures disappear.

options.title: Remove queue cleanup
options.body: Land the stack-safe parsers without automatic queue deletion and leave historical failed records user-removable.

recommendation.title: Keep targeted cleanup
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow migration after current-head browser reload proof shows only historical attachment failures disappear.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work and current-main history connect this owner most directly to both the Control UI persistence surface and shared attachment parsing.
